column1: # Answers of https://api.osv.dev recorded 2026-11-15, cut down for tests/test_v801_deb_source_matching.py.
# Q: one query (ecosystem, package, version) and the advisory ids it returned.
# A: one affected entry of an advisory (id, ecosystem, package, introduced, fixed, urgency; "-" for none).
# V: a fact of the advisory record itself (id, key, value).
# Left out: four of the seven source packages asked on the 22.04 host (openssl, bash, curl, zlib), the record dates and
# scores, the FIPS entries except those of openssl on 20.04, and the releases a test does not need (glibc, openssh and
# sudo keep 20.04, 22.04 and 24.04; openssl keeps 18.04, 20.04 and 22.04; each with its Ubuntu Pro entries).
